title: Tight-bounded local refinement from iteration-19 optimum with variance regularization
scientific_hypothesis: Constraining optimization step size to ≤0.5 nm per layer around the iteration-19 best candidate thickness vector will enable fine-grained settling within the favorable interference basin while damping resonance-induced overshooting that caused score regression in iteration 23.
design_principle: Local gradient-based optimization with tight bounds preserves the interference condition achieved at iteration 19 (target_score 0.327) while preventing large thickness excursions that degrade dual-band performance. Variance regularization penalizes total thickness deviation to maintain mechanical stability.
proposed_topology: Air | ZnSe | ZnS | ZnSe | ZnS | ZnSe | ZnS | ZnSe | ZnS | Ge substrate (8 finite layers total, alternating sequence starting with ZnSe)
design_variables: Layer thicknesses (8 variables, ±0.5 nm bounds around seed)
soft_objectives: Maximize mean transmittance in 8000-11000 nm band
Minimize mean transmittance in 3000-5000 nm band
manufacturing_considerations: ±0.5 nm thickness tolerance achievable with modern deposition control
Alternating ZnSe/ZnS sequence simplifies process monitoring
theory_basis: Transfer-matrix method for coherent multilayer interference
Quarter-wave stack theory for bandpass/bandstop design
expected_advantages: Tight bounds prevent optimizer from escaping favorable basin
known_risks: Local optimum may limit further improvement beyond 0.327
Tight bounds may prevent discovery of better global configuration
Variance regularization may conflict with spectral objectives
execution_request_english: Optimize an 8-layer planar dielectric stack on Ge substrate with Air incidence under normal-incidence unpolarized illumination. Layer sequence: ZnSe, ZnS, ZnSe, ZnS, ZnSe, ZnS, ZnSe, ZnS (8 finite layers). Initialize thicknesses at [429.3362593672488, 71.05139362686491, 69.55218027927222, 50.322318469392705, 674.5855881008958, 71.37520311661459, 49.22708022962166, 548.5304563299314] nm. Constrain each layer thickness to ±0.5 nm around initialization. Optimize for maximum mean transmittance in 8000-11000 nm band and minimum mean transmittance in 3000-5000 nm band. Apply gradient-based optimizer with thickness variance regularization penalty. Evaluate candidates using coherent transfer-matrix formalism. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 8000-11000 nm, 3000-5000 nm. soft objectives: High transmittance in 8000-11000 nm band; Low transmittance in 3000-5000 nm band. behaviors to suppress or avoid: High transmittance in 3000-5000 nm band. manufacturing constraints: Total layer count not exceeding 16.
revision_reason: Directly implements feedback directive: warm-start from iteration-19 best candidate, ≤0.5 nm step bounds, tighter variance regularization to address score regression from 0.327 to 0.198 in iteration 23.
